text: Artificial intelligence is changing our world at an incredible speed. While it brings many benefits, it also raises important ethical questions. One major concern is bias. AI systems learn from data created by humans, and if that data contains unfair patterns, the AI will reproduce them. For example, a hiring tool might unfairly reject qualified candidates because of their background. Fairness means we need to check AI decisions to ensure everyone is treated equally. Privacy is another issue, since AI often collects large amounts of personal information, and people deserve to know how it is used. Transparency is also vital. If an AI makes a decision about your loan or health, you should understand why. Ultimately, responsible AI development requires careful planning, honesty, and constant testing. We must create technology that helps everyone without causing harm.
